name: TikTok product test 01
budget_note: Campaign budget shared across all 15 ads (TikTok decides the split). Set to $120.34 by a TikTok recommendation at publish; kept at the owner's request to keep the rebate.

rebate.rule: No edits (budget, targeting, captions, videos) and no pausing until the trial ends; keep enough balance.

owner_decision: Keep the rebate: leave the $120.34 budget and auto-add on, and check daily which videos TikTok adds.
